card.name: Inside drug names, mid-name
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a longer generic drug name, such as the 'av' in edaravone or the 'id' in lurasidone. It appears mostly in drug label text, right before the drug name ends.

modes.label: Middle of drug name
modes.description: A middle piece of a generic drug name, spelled out partway before the ending.
